title: One-Hour Build Execution Log
intro: Five-minute demo playback with real elapsed times scaled to a one-hour task: five minutes for PNG-to-blueprint design and fifty-five minutes for construction, learning, cleanup, verification, and return.

meta.systemIntro: Demo playback runs for about five minutes, while displayed elapsed time represents the real one-hour task budget.
meta.cadence: 1 demo event per second; displayed elapsed time is scaled to the one-hour task
allocation: 00:00-05:00 PNG-to-blueprint design and runtime setup, 8% of the real task budget
12:00-20:00 Foreman phased split and task-board publishing
20:00-55:00 worker construction, skill sharing, retry, facade/roof work, and cleanup
55:00-60:00 board review, full verification, patching, checkpoint save, and return

stages.label: 01 Request & Environment

events.text: User submits a source PNG and opens a new CraftUtopia build run.
